entities.summary: Philippe Herreweghe (b. 1947-05-02, Ghent) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ghent and Belgium. Known in the fields of belgium, composers & musicians, europe.
